reason: Provides configurable external vision-model access plus image analysis, OCR, processing, screenshot, and image artifact tools for DeepSeek Harness.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可配置的外部视觉模型访问，以及图像分析、OCR、处理、截图和图像产物工具。
summaries.en: Provides DeepSeek Harness with configurable external vision-model access and tools for image analysis, OCR, processing, screenshots, and image artifacts.

capabilities: Sends local or remote images to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision API
Provides image analysis, OCR, detection, grounding, comparison, cropping, color extraction, vectorization, and foreground extraction tools
Can render local HTML screenshots and publish or materialize image artifacts
Can capture desktop screenshots when explicitly enabled
Reads local image files and writes generated artifacts to the workspace or temporary directories
